gloss: to visit; to call on; to pay a visit

definitions.gloss: to visit; to call on; to pay a visit
definitions.explanation: To go to someone's home, office, or institution for a purpose. More formal than {訪|たず}ねる, and implies a purposeful, planned visit rather than a casual drop-in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訪問|ほうもん}する。
⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{宅|たく}→お宅：01569_otaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訪問|ほうもん}して⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よろしい→よろしい：01176_yoroshii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: May I visit your home this afternoon?

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訪問|ほうもん}して⟦{診察|しんさつ}→診察：03259_shinsatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor visits the patient's home to examine them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{訪問|ほうもん}し、⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{激励|げきれい}→激励：15022_gekirei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The minister visited the disaster-stricken area and encouraged the residents.

notes:
A formal word for visiting that implies purpose and intent. Common in business, medical, and official contexts. The noun ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧ appears in many compound terms for professional services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: door-to-door sales
- ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧⟦{看護|かんご}→看護：13668_kango⟧: home nursing care
- ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}{介護|かいご}→訪問介護：24515_houmonkaigo⟧: home care service
- ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}{者|しゃ}→訪問者：20148_houmonsha⟧: visitor
- ⟦{家庭|かてい}{訪問|ほうもん}→家庭訪問：28190_kateihoumon⟧: home visit (by teacher)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{訪|たず}ねる→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧: to visit — slightly less formal, can be used for places or people
- {伺|うかが}う: to visit (humble) — humble form used when visiting someone of higher status
- ⟦{見舞|みま}う→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧: to visit (the sick) — specifically visiting someone who is ill or in hospital
